title: Woman Arrested in Philadelphia for Blocking Delivery Robot
excerpt: A woman was arrested and charged with disorderly conduct in Philadelphia after refusing to move from the path of an Uber delivery robot.
body_html:
A woman in Philadelphia was taken into custody and faced a charge of disorderly conduct following an incident involving an automated delivery device. Carolyn Marvin intentionally stood in front of an Uber delivery robot and refused to step aside when instructed.

Speaking to local outlet ABC13, Marvin explained her actions, stating that she intended to protest the technology because she believes such machines displace human workers. She noted that she had previously protested the delivery robots whenever she encountered them by blocking their paths.

The incident highlights growing friction regarding the deployment of automated delivery systems in public urban spaces and the forms of protest some individuals are taking against them.
